headline: Train together.
Race together.
hero.text: City of Trees Triathlon Club brings swimmers, cyclists, and runners across the Treasure Valley together, whether it's your first sprint or your next Ironman.

photo.alt: A triathlete crossing the finish line with arms out

steps.title: Join the team
steps.text: Fill out the quick form and join our Strava club so you see every session.

steps.title: Pick a session
steps.text: Check the schedule for the next ride, run, or swim and where it starts.

steps.title: Show up
steps.text: Meet the group, move at your own pace, and make it a habit.

photos.alt: A cyclist in an aero position on a road bike
photos.caption: Ride

photos.alt: A runner mid-stride during a race
photos.caption: Run

faq.q: Do I need to be an experienced triathlete?
faq.a: No. Beginners are welcome. Come to a session, meet people, and go at your own pace.
Every session on the schedule lists its start location.
Water, and the gear for the sport: a helmet and a bike in good working order for rides, and comfortable running shoes for runs.

faq.q: How do I stay in the loop?
faq.a: Join the club on Strava and check the schedule page, which is updated whenever new sessions are added.
